facts.description: Tick recomputes allow first; subtracts allScaledTime from remainingTime; keeps only an ordered result greater than the selected float32 threshold, and expires otherwise. Tick does not cast.
Stored allow bit gates hasNextSkillRequest and nextSkillId; these getters do not dequeue.
firstAttack scans m_skills ascending for SkillType zero, independent of cached request. TryCastNormalAttack returns selected TryCastSkill bool.

After interrupt and CanCastToTarget admission, buff switch may return true; ordinary path sets casting-start, writes curSkill and saves target before inline cast initialization, then clears casting-start and returns true if downstream calls return normally.

DoCast returns void, resets duration timer fields, resets one cooldown, initializes finish/cost/callback fields and reaches TimelineActionProcessor.CastStart; no Boolean acceptance is attributed to it.
